name: B10-0435/2026 – Recital G – Am 2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text: G. whereas EU-African trade and investment relations encompass various EPAs, Sustainable Investment Facilitation Agreements, Clean Trade and Investment Partnerships and other forms of engagement; whereas many sub-Saharan African countries have also concluded bilateral investment treaties with different EU Member States; whereas new trade and investment agreements with individual African countries must guarantee a level playing field with equal production standards so that European farmers and businesses are not undermined by lower standards in partner countries;
